note: A RATCHET, not an allowlist. Each entry is the number of hard-coded waitForTimeout calls a spec is still allowed to have; packages/ui/tests/unit/sleep-budget.test.ts fails the build if a file exceeds its number, if a file not listed here grows one, or if a number is left materially above reality. The numbers may only go DOWN. WHAT THIS COUNTS AND WHAT IT DOES NOT: this counts CALLS. It has never been able to say whether any individual wait was thought about, which is why sleep-declared.test.ts now sits beside it and gates the REASONS - every remaining waitForTimeout in packages/ui/tests/e2e (helpers included, which this file does not cover) must carry a "sleep-justified:" marker naming what the test would otherwise wait ON. At the baseline 137 of 222 sleeps carried no comment at all, and most of the rest described the click above them rather than the duration. WHERE THE NUMBERS CAME FROM: spec 034 measured 222 sites / 322.8 seconds when this ratchet was set, of which 233 seconds ran in a DEFAULT run (the rest sit in opt-in specs). Re-derived from the tree on 2026-08-18 after the conversion: 47 real call sites / 70.45 seconds, all declared. The total below is 50 rather than 47 because this file counts with a looser regex than the declaration guard - it matches the word in prose too - and a ratchet that is slightly loose is safer than one that disagrees with the test enforcing it. WHAT REPLACED THEM: quiesced() in harness.ts waits until a redrawing surface stops changing (two consecutive equal reads) rather than guessing how long a redraw takes; geom() does the same for geometry; stayedAbsent() makes a negative assertion state its fence. Where the real wait was for a WRITE, the replacement polls the persisted artefact - the SQLite layout row, the recovery snapshot - which is the defect class behind #246, a test that slept past a write it then could not read. WHAT IS LEFT IS MOSTLY ONE SHAPE: proving that something did NOT happen. There is no event for "a timer did not fire" or "no second notice arrived", so those wait out a real interval. Where that property could be proved with a fake clock at a lower layer it was moved there (component/notice-dismissal-timer.test.ts); where it needs a real ConPTY or a dead daemon, it stays here and says so.
